origine_fr: La main 寸, qui suit la règle, sous 土, autrefois 之, qui donnait le son. C'était une cour de l'administration. Selon la tradition, on y logea les premiers moines venus d'Inde : 寺 devint le temple bouddhiste.
origine_en: The hand 寸, following the rules, under 土, once 之, which gave the sound. It was a government court. Tradition says the first monks from India were lodged in one, and 寺 became the Buddhist temple.

phrase.pinyin: Shān shang yǒu yī zuò gǔ sì.
phrase.fr: Il y a un temple ancien sur la montagne.
phrase.en: There is an old temple on the mountain.
